author: m1simulator
quote: A beautiful remaster of an already amazing game, in the legend of zelda you start as link, a young boy left at the great deku tree as an orphan **** war. A destined hero who is set off to defeat the great evil ganondorf, with an ocarina of time, that plays multiple songs that bring you to different locations, change the weather, and even summons your steed epona, this is a great game and a great adventure to go off on again, now with remastered graphics, voice acting, and improvements upon the original game that made it already so great.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: m1simulator
quote: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is a difficult castlevania game, much more challenging than other ds era style castlevania games most people are accustomed to. while beautiful looking. the gameplay feels much different and much more difficult, If you can get past that and the first half of the game, you will find that it starts to speed up tremendously and will feel much more fluid for the second half of the game. overall while decent it did not give me the feel that bloodstained gave me and needs just a little bit more work to really get back into the castlevania roots.

author: m1simulator
quote: Unfortunately, as much as i loved gta 5, this game simply does not live up to the hype and expectations that everybody wanted it to, with 30 frames sometimes dropping into the low 20's boring protagonist characters. and a ton of bugs. with a drawn out storyline full of chores and mundane daily activities, this just isnt the gta we all loved and expected.

author: m1simulator
quote: One of the greatest most influential games of all time. A story of a young boy raised by the deku tree as the chosen hero to fight off the great evil ganondorf. a game that still holds up to this day.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
